title: Refine Your Web Fonts: Master OpenType Features with CSS 'font-feature-settings' for Superior UI Design
tweet: Elevate your #WebFonts with #CSSTypography! Discover how 'font-feature-settings' unlocks OpenType features like ligatures, fractions, & old-style figures for superior #UIDesign & #UserExperience. Transform your text today! #WebDev
tip: When implementing 'font-feature-settings', always test across different browsers and ensure your chosen web font actually supports the OpenType features you're trying to activate. Not all fonts are created equal, and some features might render differently or not at all if unsupported. Start with common features like 'liga' for standard ligatures to subtly improve readability and visual flow.
